summary: Develop water balances, demand scenarios and reporting tools through applied water resource management training. Explore the course outline.
lede: Water resource management helps water and environmental professionals assess availability, balance supply and demand, and plan water-system performance. Using integrated water resources management and water-balance methods, participants build baselines, forecast demand, compare allocation scenarios, identify efficiency actions, and set monitoring indicators. They also practise creating performance scorecards and concise progress reports from practical water data.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess water availability, plan use, operate water systems or report water-related performance. It connects resource planning with the operational decisions and evidence these roles handle.
prerequisites: The supplied course information does not specify any prerequisites. Familiarity with water use, water services, environmental management or resource planning can help you relate the exercises to your work.
topics: Water & wastewater treatment and utility management
